messages.author: 3b104dc6686d0c85
messages.subject: Re: API Documentation
parts:
Hi Rodrigo,

in case you missed yesterday's announcement: we have put up a completely revised guide for Renjin at http://docs.renjin.org. This guide also includes documentation for a small subset of the API. It's a work in progress, but hopefully this already answers many of your questions.

Regards,

Maarten-Jan

I think we'll try to get that published automatically with each build and linked to readthedocs, but in the meantime if you've got the source downloaded, you can generate them with 

mvn javadoc:aggregator

HTH,
Alex
